homeTitle: A common voice for the households here.
lead: Dr. CRP Nagar Residents' Association speaks for the households of Chempakaraman Pillai Nagar, Pangappara. The public site carries notices, meetings, contacts, and papers that every resident should be able to find.
paragraphs: The association looks after shared concerns: lanes and lighting, waste, water and power follow-up, and the gatherings that keep neighbours known to one another. It is not a substitute for the corporation, the police, or the electricity and water departments. It is the place those concerns are collected and taken to the right desk.

This website is public on purpose. Emergency numbers, notices, and forms should not sit behind a login. A residents-only section, for membership and complaints, can be added later without replacing these pages.

responsibilities.title: Lanes and lighting
responsibilities.text: Follow up on street lights, drains, and other problems that affect more than one house.

responsibilities.title: Waste
responsibilities.text: Share collection days and ask households to put waste out only in that window.

responsibilities.title: Water and power
responsibilities.text: Pass common supply problems to the Kerala Water Authority and KSEB section offices.

responsibilities.title: Safety
responsibilities.text: For danger, call 112. The association can still record a repeated concern for the committee to raise.

responsibilities.title: Meetings
responsibilities.text: Publish the date, the place, and the minutes so a household that could not attend can still read what was decided.

responsibilities.title: Gatherings
responsibilities.text: Make room for festivals and small neighbourhood events when residents want them.

howWeWork.title: The general body decides
howWeWork.text: Households meet, discuss, and decide. The committee does not replace that meeting.

howWeWork.title: The committee carries the day-to-day work
howWeWork.text: Office bearers follow up between meetings and report back.

howWeWork.title: Money is reported
howWeWork.text: Collections and spending are for the general body to see. Accounts can be attached with the minutes.

area.title: The area this site is for
points: Dr. CRP Nagar, also known as CRP Nagar and Chempakaraman Pillai Nagar.
If a lane or a row of houses should be named on this page, the secretary can add it.
